run_lintrunner_version_check: run the lintrunner version linter to check if lintrunner is installed and up to date
create_LintMessage: create a LintMessage NamedTuple with path, line, code, severity, name, and description fields
use_LintSeverity: use the LintSeverity enum to set error, warning, advice, or disabled severity levels
convert_version_to_string: convert a version tuple like (0, 10, 7) to a dotted string using toVersionString
check_lintrunner_installation: check if lintrunner is installed by running the script and parsing the version output
